release.notes: Adds optional teacher-reviewed term grade publishing to the private Student Portal. In Grades > Term 1-3 overview > Student portal grades, select terms, review complete grades and confirm publication. Students see released term grades by subject and school year; final grades appear only after every taught term is released. Later local edits remain private until republished. Remove published grades for one subject without removing activities, attendance or groupings. Includes all pending portal grade controls, updated fictional demo and current portal assets. The live website already retains sign-in through refresh for up to 30 minutes, with server-side expiry and revocation; no access code is stored in browser storage. Existing classroom records, settings, activation and student access codes are preserved. No records or grades upload automatically, and publishing credentials are never bundled.
